notes: PleaToken (src/PleaToken.sol) is the pleaimd (PLEA) token: a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on vendored OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.4.0. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 PLEA (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, the ProjectFactory, and emits SupplyMinted. There is no other mint path, no owner, no roles, no pause, blacklist, freeze, fee, tax, burn hook or upgrade path: every transfer and transferFrom moves exactly the amount asked for, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the pool seed through the PoolManager and the remainder to economics.remainderTo all arrive whole, and no address needs to be exempted. The runtime bytecode contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. The launch deploys no application contracts and makes no initialization calls; there is nothing to configure after launch. The pool pairs PLEA with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
